Find the Laplace transform Y(s)=L{y(t)} for s>0 if 2y′+2y=4+t2,y(0)=0.

b
Y(s)=4s+12s3(s+1)

d
Y(s)=s2−2s3(s+1)

Y(s)=4s2+14s(s+1)
